host_outcomes.PASS: valid structured result with no findings; host may continue to deliberate second-pass review
host_outcomes.WARN: valid structured result with non-blocking findings; host preserves diagnostics and continues only when profile permits
host_outcomes.BLOCK: one or more blocking findings; host prevents execution/handoff and returns control to repair
host_outcomes.CHECKER_FAILURE: Lua/runtime/schema/checker failure; host fails closed and never reinterprets it as PASS

proof_ceiling: Contract for one command-text inspection lane. It does not prove arbitrary shell semantics, production command execution, hostile-script sandbox escape resistance, or every command class.
